errors.apiReturnedHtml: The API returned HTML instead of data. Another server is probably running at {origin}. Stop it or run autonomo-web on another port.
errors.deduction_facts_missing: The selected deduction rule needs more facts. Complete them in the rule card and save the draft.
errors.deduction_exceeds_rule: The IRPF or IVA deduction is above the rule''s ceiling. Enter the proposal or less, or choose no rule.
errors.deduction_rule_unknown: The selected deduction rule is not in this version''s catalog. Choose another rule or no rule.
errors.deduction_out_of_scope: The selected deduction rule does not cover this expense. Choose no rule and enter the amounts manually.
errors.deduction_rule_conflict: The deduction rule changed without a new catalog date. Posting is stopped until the catalog is fixed; contact the operator.
